answer: A tLS certificate history with certificate authority attestation works as the gate: certificates renewed for the same domain for years. Each of 141 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The pearl check runs in the open: 141 fakes pay the full price 141 times, one honest agent pays once, and the river trail in the ledger makes the zephyr cost visible to everyone.
